problem: The candidate imposes exactly one ice type classification on every ship, but the requirement only defines a conditional rule when the ice type is thin first-year ice and does not mandate presence or single-valued cardinality.
required_change: Remove sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1 from the iceTypeClassification property unless an explicit mandatory single-valued ownership requirement is supplied.
regression_guard: Preserve the conditional thickness rule without inventing a universal classification cardinality.

problem: The candidate restricts numericValue to xsd:decimal, although the authoritative iceThickness term specifies no datatype and the requirement only requires a numeric metre-valued thickness.
required_change: Remove the xsd:decimal datatype restriction and make the conditional comparison accept the supported numeric literal datatypes, while retaining the metre-unit and numeric-range semantics.
regression_guard: Preserve numeric comparison bounds of 0.3 m and 0.7 m inclusive and the required metre unit.
